section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering

content.description: Upper bracket assembly showing wiring clamp installation with two bolts

items: (a) Apply anaerobic adhesive and sealant (THREE BOND 1324 (Part No. 08833-00070) or equivalent) to 1 or 2 threads of the bolt end.

content.text: NOTE: This adhesive will not harden while exposed to air. It will act as a sealer or binding agent only when applied between of threads, etc. and air is cut off.
(b) Install the two bolts; one with a wiring clamp.

content.description: Column bracket installation showing bracket attachment to column tube

content.text: 8. ASSEMBLE COLUMN BRACKET TO COLUMN TUBE
9. CONNECT MAIN SHAFT AND INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
Align the marks on the joint flange and intermediate shaft and tighten the bolt.

content.description: Installation of tension springs and cords showing connection points to hanger, support and cord guides

content.text: 10. INSTALL TWO SPRINGS AND TWO CORDS

items: (a) Connect the tension spring and cord, and hook the spring to the hanger.
(b) Pry the spring end and hook the cord end to the support.
(c) Hook the cords to the cord guides.

content.text: 11. CHECK OPERATION OF TILT STEERING LEVER AND SUPPORT

items: (a) Check that there is no axial or horizontal play at the end of the main shaft.
(b) Check that the main shaft lock securely in all six positions.

content.description: Ignition switch installation showing key cylinder being inserted into upper bracket with key turned to ACC position

content.text: Turn the ignition key plate to the ACC position, and install the key cylinder into the upper bracket.
